مشروع is also a common adjective meaning lawful/legitimate; the current noun-only entry under-specifies a high-frequency reading.
بطولة also commonly means heroism/bravery, not only a championship or tournament.
هيئة commonly also means form/appearance/shape; the current institutional glosses omit this major sense.
proposed_english: form; appearance; body; authority; commission; organization

note: Unvocalized إذن also represents إِذْن 'permission/authorization'; the current entry gives only the discourse-particle reading.
proposed_english: then; therefore; in that case (إِذًا/إذن); permission; authorization (إِذْن)

note: ألا is also the very common negative-question sequence أَ + لا ('don't/doesn't/isn't... ?'), which is important for learners and is used elsewhere in this workbook.
proposed_english: attention/emphasis particle; that not (أَلَّا); don't/doesn't/isn't... ? (أَ + لا)
